title: Saint Martin de Porres, Religious
short_summary: Saint Martin de Porres is honored in the Dominican calendar as a religious whose humble charity and service made visible the mercy of Christ.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Martin de Porres as a feast on November 3.
The Order of Preachers identifies him as a Dominican religious.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Martin was born in Lima, Peru, in 1579.
His feast is shown as a Dominican proper observance in the app, not as a replacement for the general U.S. calendar day.

sections.heading: Humble service
sections.body: Martin's holiness is remembered through charity, humility, and care for those in need. His Dominican witness shows that preaching the Gospel includes works of mercy.

sections.heading: A saint of the Dominican family
sections.body: The Dominican calendar honors Martin as part of the Order's proper rhythm of prayer. The app presents that observance only for users who choose the Dominican calendar preference.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Mercy made concrete
catholic_connection_sections.body: Martin's life reminds the faithful that love of Christ must become patient, practical charity toward neighbors.
